description.text: Materials Science and Engineering is one of the key engineering majors of Wenzhou University, and materials science is a key discipline in Zhejiang Province, a top priority discipline of Wenzhou University, and a key discipline of Wenzhou University's "Discipline Enhancement Strategy" construction project. In 1998, Wenzhou University opened the main courses of materials science and engineering, polymer chemistry and other materials. In 2002, he began to enroll undergraduate majors in materials science and engineering. In 2014, in response to the development needs of materials discipline, the Department of Materials Science and Engineering was established, which is affiliated to the School of Chemistry and Materials Engineering. The Department of Materials Science and Engineering is oriented to meet the needs of the material industry in the fields of socialist modernization and scientific and technological development, combined with the development needs of the new materials industry, and strives to cultivate a strong sense of innovation and social responsibility, good humanistic qualities and healthy psychological quality, and can engage in the research and development, design, production and management of new materials and products in the fields of plastics, rubber, fiber, synthetic leather, semiconductor materials, functional ceramic materials, new energy materials, biological and medical materials, environmental materials, etc. Application-oriented and composite senior engineering technology and engineering management talents with strong engineering practice ability.

duration.text: The Materials Science and Engineering at Wenzhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Graduation certificate of highest education level attained*Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.2.An official transcript from the college you have recently attended.* Official transcript should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3.Two Recommendation letters ( only for Master applicant)4.Certificate of English proficiency test*IELTS or TOEFL will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker (A minimum score should be obtained as follows: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT70, or TOEFL paper based 550 ）5.Applicants to Chinese programs must pass HSK grade 5 or above6.A photocopy of your passport.7.Bank statement (normally the balance is enough for your first year tuition fee and accommodation fee )8.No Criminal Report (if necessary)9.Health report ( within the validation period)10.Recommendation letters from two experts (assistant porfessors, associate professors, or professors)11.Self-introduction vedio12.Study Plan of no less than 1000 words.

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2.University graduate or equivalent to a Chinese University graduate (Master Degree Applicant)3.Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
